tool.name: CpptrajDensity
tool.description: : Wrapper of the Ambertools Cpptraj module for calculating density profile along an axis of a given cpptraj compatible trajectory.

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input TOP,PDB,PRMTOP,PARMTOP,ZIP file
param.help: Path to the input structure or topology file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input MDCRD,CRD,CDF,NETCDF,NC,RESTART,NCRESTART,RESTARTNC,DCD,CHARMM,COR,PDB,MOL2,TRR,GRO,BINPOS,XTC,CIF,ARC,SQM,SDF,CONFLIB file
param.help: Path to the input trajectory to be processed. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_cpptraj_path
param.label: output DAT,AGR,XMGR,GNU name
param.help: Path to the output processed density analysis Format: [output].[format]

param.name: outname_output_traj_path
param.label: output MDCRD,CRD,CDF,NETCDF,NC,RESTART,NCRESTART,RESTARTNC,DCD,CHARMM,COR,PDB,MOL2,TRR,GRO,BINPOS,XTC,CIF,ARC,SQM,SDF,CONFLIB name
param.help: Path to the output processed trajectory Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: start
param.label: start
param.help: Starting frame for slicing

param.name: end
param.label: end
param.help: Ending frame for slicing

param.name: steps
param.label: steps
param.help: Step for slicing

param.name: density_type
param.label: density_type
param.help: Number, mass, partial charge (q) or electron (Ne - q) density. Electron density will be converted to e-/Å3 by dividing the average area spanned by the other two dimensions.

param.name: mask
param.label: mask
param.help: Arbitrary number of masks for atom selection; a dataset is created and the output will contain entries for each mask.. Default: all atoms.

param.name: delta
param.label: delta
param.help: Resolution, i.e. determines number of slices (i.e. histogram bins).

param.name: axis
param.label: axis
param.help: Coordinate (axis) for density calculation. Vales: x, y, z.

param.name: bintype
param.label: bintype
param.help: or bin edges.

param.name: restrict
param.label: restrict
param.help: If specified, only calculate the density within a cylinder or square shape from the specified axis as defined by a distance cutoff.

param.name: cutoff
param.label: cutoff
param.help: The distance cutoff for 'restrict'. Required if 'restrict' is specified.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the cpptraj executable binary.

param.name: output_cpptraj_path_format
param.label: output_cpptraj_path_format
param.help: Format of the output file

param.name: output_traj_path_format
param.label: output_traj_path_format
param.help: Format of the output file
